ca-bc|ki: British Columbia and Kiribati both show a gold sun over wavy blue and white bands. British Columbia has the Union Jack and a crown across the top; Kiribati has a red sky with a gold frigatebird.
ca-mb|ca-on: Manitoba and Ontario are both red ensigns with the Union Jack in the corner and a shield in the fly. Manitoba's shield has a bison standing on a rock; Ontario's has three gold maple leaves.
ca-nb|ca-pe: New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island both have a gold lion on a red band across the top. New Brunswick has a black galley on gold and water below; Prince Edward Island has oak trees on white and a red-and-white border.
ca-nt|ca-yt: The Northwest Territories and Yukon both have a wide white centre with an emblem between coloured side panels. The Northwest Territories have blue on both sides and a plain shield; Yukon has green at the hoist, blue at the fly and a full coat of arms over fireweed.
ca|ca-nt: Canada and the Northwest Territories share the same layout of a white square between two side bands. Canada's bands are red with a red maple leaf; the Northwest Territories' are blue with a shield in the centre.
